hints.title: Single-Child Parent Identification
hints.text: A node is lonely if and only if its parent has exactly one child.

hints.title: Parent-Level Child Inspection
hints.text: During traversal from a parent node, test whether exactly one of left or right is present.

hints.title: Recursive Collection
hints.text: If parent has only a left child, record left.val; if parent has only a right child, record right.val.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: N: number of nodes in binary tree
complexity.notes: Visits every node once during DFS traversal with recursion stack depth bounded by tree height H.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Tracking parent pointers requires auxiliary storage or extra passes.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Inspecting children directly from each node avoids parent hash table allocation.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Simple depth-first search inspecting child presence at the parent level.
